pilot_disclosure: A seed-42 length-8 pilot already showed small first-KDA error, depth amplification, and persistence under the Torch KDA recurrence. The full matrix confirms or rejects that disclosed routing hypothesis; it is not a blind discovery experiment.
prefix_rule: For each seed, generate one deterministic 512-token sequence and use exact prefixes for shorter lengths in every execution mode.

execution_matrices.kda_backend: FLA chunk for full sequence and FLA fused recurrent for one-token decode
auditable Torch recurrence for both full sequence and one-token decode
execution_matrices.purpose: test whether FLA chunk-versus-recurrent kernels are the sole source

execution_matrices.kda_backend: auditable Torch recurrence with every delayed causal-convolution tap set to zero after initialization
execution_matrices.purpose: test whether causal-convolution history is the sole source while retaining current-token convolution scaling

capture.layerwise_position: last token of each tested prefix
metrics: mismatched elements under the frozen tolerance
token argmax agreement and disagreement positions

numerical_contract.source: the existing Paper 1 preflight and Transformers parity gate
numerical_contract.change_rule: This diagnostic may classify the failure but cannot widen the observed tolerance. Any revised numerical contract requires a separately justified version.

analysis.first_failure: first execution-ordered module whose last-token output has at least one element outside tolerance
analysis.amplification: final-logit relative RMS divided by first-operation relative RMS; report undefined values rather than adding epsilon
analysis.fla_sole_cause_falsifier: Torch-KDA CUDA retains token disagreement or at least half of native KDA final-logit relative RMS in the matching seed/length cell
analysis.convolution_history_sole_cause_falsifier: Torch-KDA with delayed convolution taps removed retains token disagreement or at least half of Torch-KDA final-logit relative RMS in the matching seed/length cell
analysis.state_semantics_bug_signal: CPU sentinel violates the same tolerance
analysis.reporting: retain every cell; summarize medians and ranges across seeds without promotion-authority inference

decision_scope: Classify and route the preflight failure only. No architecture quality, efficiency, tolerance, or promotion claim is authorized.
